'''Jera''' is serving maid who works at [[The White Ring]] in [[Maderin]].

She served [[Mat]] and [[Tuon]] when they were in The White Ring.

She is a smiling and curvaceous but Mat pays her no second glances, since Tuon - his "wife-to-be" - is with him.
